content.content: Attention-Based Sequence Transduction with Residual Scaling

We propose a simple network architecture based solely on attention mechanisms. Experiments on two translation tasks show that our model achieves 28.4 BLEU on English-to-German, improving over the best existing results by 2.0 BLEU, while requiring significantly less time to train.
Recurrent networks [4] have been the dominant approach. In this work we show that attention alone suffices.
